en:
So, if I go with you,
I know I can get there.

Besides, it's only natural to help
out your friend when they need it!

All right then.
I'll be expecting great things.

Leave it to me!
Let's do it, Kazuma-kun!

Hey, Kazuma-kun.
Want some tofu!?

Thanks a lot!
Come back soon, okay!?
Come back soon, Kazuma-kun!
Hm? It feels like someone's watching me.
I must be imagining it.
No time for questions.
What the hell just happened to me?
Hey. Y'look like y'just saw a ghost.
Y'did see it, didn't ya? Carryin' a sword.
Y-Yeah. I actually did more than just see it.

Well, I'm the gravekeeper 'round these parts.
Stopped by 'cause somethin' felt off tonight.
Guess that was yer fault.
Wait. You've seen the ghost here, too?
Y'ain't from here, are ya?

Local folks wouldn't dare swing 'round my graveyard.
Even kids're afraid t'come anywhere near.

Honestly, I ain't even heard of an outsider who
was brave enough t'show his face in here.
Huh. I had no idea.

Don't worry 'bout it.
I ain't tryin' to bring ya down.

If the legends're true, the ghosts that show up 'round
here are pirates who raided the Inland Sea ages ago.
(Pirates...?)

These guys're a real rowdy bunch.
Even in death, they're always itchin' fer a fight.

If yer feelin' up to it, y'should come
back and humor 'em sometime.

Pirate ghosts, huh?
Even in a quiet town like this, I can't catch a break.

Something feels off again.
It must be the pirate ghosts.
Long time no see.
What? There are two of you?
Ugh, that's enough sleeping on the ground for me.
I knew ya'd be back.
Old man.
What's yer name, kid?
It's Kiryu. Kazuma Kiryu.

Kiryu-san, huh? Our spectral buddies're
really warmin' up to ya.
And how exactly do you know that?

I've been watchin' over this place fer years.
I can tell how they feel.

Y'probly can't feel it, but there's a real lively
energy flowin' through the air right now.

Well it's usually real gloomy 'round here,
but it feels like the ghosts're takin' a shine t'ya.
Bet they're jus' lovin' all these fights.
This doesn't make much sense.

Y'know what? Y'might jus' be the one
t'finally put their souls t'rest.
The ghosts are here. I can feel it.
I'm not that interested in fighting you guys.

But I've done this much. I'll keep
going until your souls are at peace.
Let's do this.
Ugh, I wish I didn't pass out every time.

Hm? It doesn't look like
the gravekeeper's coming this time.
They should be here soon.

So you're still trying to up the ante.
Think three of you is enough to stop me?

You guys are quick, but I promise you won't be
getting the jump on me any time soon.
Every time it's the same thing...
So yer back in style, Kiryu-san.

Thanks t'ya, the fog that's been hangin' over
this graveyard's finally startin' t'clear up.

I reckon it's 'cause yer resolvin' the regrets
those ghosts have about their ol' lives.

Who exactly are you, old man?
Are you some kind of psychic?

Well, I'm roughly a tenth-generation
descendant of the ghosts y'been fightin'.
You're related to them?

Y'remember how I said they used t'be pirates
back when they were still alive?

T'be more precise, they were actually mercenaries
who were hired by a big band o' pirates.

Back 'round Nobunaga's time, in the 1500s, the pirates
o' Hiroshima got in a real big war with each other.

In order t'tip the scales in their favor, one group
o' pirates hired these three legendary mercenaries.

Story goes those three coulda taken over the whole
country with jus' a sword if they were feelin' up to it.
Turns out they didn't really have sea legs, though.

Got so sick they couldn't even draw their swords.
They actually ended up fallin' overboard n' drownin'.
All three of them?
Mhm. All at the same time.
That's absurd.

'Cause their prized mercenaries were gone, the pirates
who hired 'em got obliterated by a rival crew.

So, the three of 'em died without fully honin'
their skills. 'At's what they're regrettin' now.
And that's why they're so eager to fight.

As their descendant, I've been hopin' fer a while now
that somebody'd come along n' lay 'em down fer good.

'Til that happens, they're jus' gonna
keep wanderin' around this graveyard.

I gotta say, though... I'm thinkin' y'might be
the one who can finally put 'em to rest.

Yer probly the only person in the world who's
got the raw manpower y'need to do it. So...

Jus' one more fight. A final flourish t'let their
souls drift into the ether in peace. Please, Kiryu-san.

Our last battle, huh?
It'll be sad to say goodbye.

It seems like this will be the last time
I deal with these graveyard ghosts.
Right, then. They really are ready to end this.
Hey, can I ask a favor of you guys?

I always wake up on the ground after our fights,
so my clothes get covered in dirt.
I was hoping you could help me with that somehow.
I wonder if they heard me...

This is... my apartment?
How did I get here?

And what ended up happening to the ghosts?
I should head over to the graveyard...

Allow me t'thank ya. 'Cause of ya,
my ancestors can finally rest in peace.
How can you tell, old man?
Trust me, I have my ways.

I've really gotta thank ya fer this. Y'did
what none o' their descendants could ever manage.

Honestly, I enjoyed going up against them, too.
It turned into some pretty decent sparring practice.
Interestin'.

Y'know, I've always regretted not bein' able t'help
my ancestors. Guess ya helped ease my regrets, too.

Oh yeah. I'd be honored if ya'd accept this,
Kiryu-san. It's the only way I got t'thank ya.

It's a talisman t'ward off spirits n' the like.
Y'won't see any more ghosts so long as yer holdin' it.
That's almost depressing to hear.
Does that mean...
Hold on, just what was all of that...?
What in the world is this?

Ah, so that's where Michio-kun's head is.
Finally found you!

What was that lazy brat thinking,
leaving something as special as you out here?
Hey, what is that thing?
Oh, sorry. I hope it didn't scare you too much.

This little guy is the head of
our stunning Ono Michio-kun.
Ono Michio-kun...?

Yup! He's an original mascot we're trying to
promote as the sparkling new face of Onomichi!
A mascot...?
Huh? Do you not know what those are?

Well, sort of. Aren't they those cute character
things that have been popping up recently?

Precisely! These days, they're most commonly
used as PR to boost local tourism and culture.

I'm in a real bind here, though.
My usual actor's flown the coop.
You have an actor?

Of course. A part-timer who donned the guise of
Michio-kun to spread cheer to the world.

All I did was give him a few pointers.
Kids these days can't take a little criticism.

But honestly, we have a big event coming up.
Michio-kun's supposed to make a dazzling appearance.

What a mess...
I'm in hot water without an actor.
Why don't you do it yourself?

No no, I'm all about management.
I can't act and run the event at the same time.

Michio-kun's pretty darn big for one of these
mascots, too. Heavy doesn't begin to describe it.

I need my actor to be tall and muscular. A wimpy guy
like me would never last the whole event.

But where could I possibly find someone big and
strong enough to handle the role? What a pickle...
Hmmm!?
I don't like where this is going.
I found one!
I'm not getting in that thing.

Come on, please!
I'll make it up to you somehow!

Michio-kun needs someone like you. You're big,
you're strong, and you have tons of time on your hands!
This really isn't my style.

I'm begging you!
I'll do whatever it takes to get you in there!

Besides, there are countless precious little children
waiting for Michio-kun's performance.

Think of their smiling faces.
You don't want to leave them disappointed, do you?

Please help me!
You need to protect their innocent smiles!

I'm not really interested in being a mascot...
What should I do?
Let me think about it.

Okay! I'll be waiting right in
this very spot until you're ready!

All right, I'll do it.
Just for a bit.
Thank you so much, Michio-kun!
Hey, I'm not Michio yet. The name's Kiryu.

Kiryu-san! I'm the producer for this event, Hironaka.
We're gonna make a great team!

Now let's get moving! The sooner we make you
into Ono Michio-kun, the better! Come on!

Won't you please be my mascot actor?
I'm begging you!
Oooh, it's perfect! You're a great fit!
Hey, do I really have to go through with this?

Don't sound so hesitant! It'll be impossible
to find someone else who suits it so well!

It's heavy, though. And hot. And hard to breathe in.
I can see why your old actor ran off.

Cheer up, guy. Ono Michio-kun is the new symbol
of Onomichi! He's like an idol for these people!
What does any of this have to do with Onomichi, anyway?
Huh!? You can't tell?

First up is his charming face, carefully modeled off
the local town of Setouchi's specialty hassaku orange!

On top of that rests a steamy hat based on
Onomichi's traditional food, Onomichi ramen!

Around his waist we have a deliciously fishy pouch
to show how much this town adores its seafood!

And on his feet, cool rubber boots serve
as a sign of our community's fisherman roots!

Finally, Ono Michio-kun's shirt has his name, O-N-O,
emblazoned on the front in big, bold letters!

He's a great representation of our town's beauty.
Don't you think he's just the perfect little mascot?
I don't think I'd go that far...

Either way, just be confident! You look amazing,
Kiryu-san! Or should I say, Michio-kun!
So, what do you need me to do?

Oh yeah. The kids will be showing up soon,
so let's start with a performance! Make it fun for them!

But, whatever you do, don't under any
circumstances break character!
And what character is that?

Ono Michio-kun is an Onomichi-based fisherman who
loves the ocean, so he should be as refined as possible.
This face, refined?

As for your speech mannerisms, you'll need to
use "michi" in your greetings when you can.
Michi?

"Hello-michi!" or "Nice to michi!"
Things like that.

Let's give it a little test drive.
Nice to michi! And, go!
Nice to michi...

You're getting the hang of it now!
Just give it some more energy for the event, okay?

Next is... the delightful catchphrase
we have for when you find yourself in trouble.
In those situations, just say "Oh no!"
Another round of practice! Ready, and...
Oh no...

Excellent! By the by, the English phrase "oh no"
sounds just like the Ono of your name. Cool, huh?
I can't imagine anyone who'd think that's cool...
One more thing! This is the last one!
There's still more? What now...?
Ono Michio-kun's charismatic pose!
I have to pose?
Michio!

Just follow my example!
It's mostly for when you arrive at and leave events.
This really isn't for me...

Come on, don't be such a downer!
Just think of the children!
Your turn! Here we go!

Kiryu-san... That was impeccable!
There's no doubt. You've really become Ono Michio!
Well that's upsetting...

Oh! The kids should be just about here!
You can do it, big guy. Just give it your all!

There aren't many rules beyond what I told you,
so just try to relax and you'll be okay!

You're cutting me loose, huh?
Anything could happen, you know.

It'll be fine! You're Ono Michio, Kiryu-san!
Ah, here they are! Go for the gold!
Whoa, it's Ono Michio!
You're right! It's really him!
I'm so happy he's here! Yay, Ono Michio-kun!

I guess this thing is more popular than I thought.
Well, here goes nothing.
Hi. I'm Ono Michio.

Looks like I need to put a little more energy into it.
Not much choice now.
Hiya, kiddos! It's me!
With my charming hassaku face!
Steamy Onomichi ramen hat!
Cute fish pouch!
Cool boots, vital for any fisherman!

And my bold and trendy Ono shirt!
That's right, I'm the pride of Onomichi...
If it's fun you want... then bring it on!
Man oh man! He's so cool!
I'm in love!
His voice is amazing!
It's all in a day's work.

All right. I hope you kiddos are ready to play.
Now then!
Nice to meet you.
Huh? Nice to meet you...?
R-Right, I remember now.
Nice to michi!
Yay! Nice to michi!

What a mess.
This mascot stuff really takes it out of you.
Michio-kun! Take this!
Blam! Pow! Biff! Zap!
Take this, and this!
These little...
You brats are gonna pay for this!
I'm so scared... Why won't he say "oh no"?
So that's what they wanted... Sorry about that.
Yippee! He said it, he really said it!
Oh no! Oh no!

Aha. That's what they were after all along.
I should have realized sooner.
C'mon! Let's play, Michio-kun!

Michio-kun! It's time for the main event!
Your talk show awaits!
